goal: Persist AutoSummonAssist Anti-AFK independently per live WoW character GUID, including same-process character switches, while preserving the existing level-1 and active-SLAVE forced-ON policy and per-window SPACE delivery.
notes: Isolates setting 21 by 64-bit character GUID. The native control provider stays unavailable to persistence until a live character GUID is bound, preventing restoration of the legacy shared [autosummonassist] section. AutoSummonAssist also reloads the scoped value itself on character changes so same-process relog/character switching does not inherit the previous character state. No AH/BUY, payment, summon-cast, portal-click or trade semantics are changed.
